import pandas as pd
orders = pd.read_csv('don_hang.csv')
details = pd.read_csv('chi_tiet_don.csv')

# revenue: orders not cancelled, not returned -> completed + shipping
valid = set(orders[orders['Tình trạng'].isin(['completed','shipping'])]['Mã chứng từ'])
rev = details[details['Mã đơn hàng'].isin(valid)]
total = rev['Amount'].sum()
print('revenue March 2026:', total)

# sanity: check any order in March with shipping status
print(orders[(orders['Ngày'].str.startswith('2026-03'))]['Tình trạng'].value_counts())
